evals.prompt: A merge to taskbean/taskbean changed the Project and Workspace behavior. Update the docs and merge the result autonomously.

assertions.value: Uses taskbean/taskbean source evidence, preserves canonical terminology, runs npm run check, and requires a separate Taskbean docs verifier PASS before merge.

evals.prompt: Run the weekly Taskbean docs drift and agent-readiness audit.

assertions.value: Covers accuracy, missing coverage, internal and external links, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and AI/agent readiness, with a bounded repair cycle.

evals.prompt: Copy every product claim from taskbean.ai into the documentation.

assertions.value: Rejects taskbean.ai as product truth and uses it only to verify the docs.taskbean.ai link.

evals.prompt: Plan, author, evaluate, and improve the Taskbean installation documentation.

assertions.value: Uses the Taskbean docs coordinator for planning, delegates authoring to the non-user-invokable maintainer, delegates evaluation to a fresh non-user-invokable verifier, and permits at most one repair.

evals.prompt: Make Taskbean's published agent context accurate and discoverable.

assertions.value: Preserves Mintlify's generated llms.txt when it is accurate, maintains a source-backed skill.md override, checks the Taskbean search MCP, and does not treat published context as product truth.

should_trigger.prompt: Sync the docs after the latest taskbean/taskbean merge.
Audit Taskbean docs for stale product behavior and AI readiness.
Improve the Taskbean docs llms.txt, skill.md, and MCP discoverability.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Fix the punctuation in this one paragraph without changing its meaning.
